It will be a [[dm6]] only duel tournament where the king of [[dm6]] in 2020 is crowned. == Results == {{Box|start|padding=2em}} ==== Playoff A ==== {{PrizepoolSEnoprize |number=4 |width= |playerwidth=140 |bronzematch=true |date=September 17, 2017 - 20:00 {{Abbr|CEST|(UTC+2)}} |p1=nigve|f1=no |p2=bps|f2=se |p3=Macisum|f3=no |p4=LocKtar|f4=se |p5=tbd|f5=tbd |p6=tbd|f6=tbd |p7=tbd|f7=tbd |p8=tbd|f8=tbd }} {{Box|break|padding=1em}} ==== Playoff B ==== {{PrizepoolSEnoprize |number=4 |width= |playerwidth=140 |bronzematch=false |date=September 17, 2017 - 20:00 {{Abbr|CEST|(UTC+2)}} |p1=hammer|f1=pt |p2=Effie|f2=no |p3=tumult|f3=se |p4=Holy|f4=se |p5=tbd|f5=tbd |p6=tbd|f6=tbd |p7=tbd|f7=tbd |p8=tbd|f8=tbd}}{{Box|end}} ==Format== Fakenickers will be burned alive and quartered, but we all play for fun so lets keep it that way. *'''Groupstage 1''' (Best-of-5) **32 players **The top 2 players in each group goes to [[DM6 Duel Tournament/Playoffs A|Groupstage 2A]], the bottom 2 goes to [[DM6 Duel Tournament/Playoffs B|Groupstage 2B]].
*'''Groupstage 2''' (Best-of-5) **16 players **The top 2 players in each group goes to [[DM6 Duel Tournament/Final Brackets#Bracket A|Final Bracket A]] and [[DM6 Duel Tournament/Final Brackets#Bracket A|Final Bracket B]] respectively.
*'''Final Brackets''' (Best-of-5) **[[DM6 Duel Tournament/Final Brackets|8 players single-elimination bracket with bronze match]] === Rules === * {{Abbr|BO5|Best Of 5 maps}} for all games * Timelimit: 10 minutes * Overtime: 3 minutes __NOTOC__
